workflow: An associative-container lookup invokes user-defined key behavior while resolving an insertion or retrieval.
That user-defined behavior clears and reinitializes the same container during the active lookup.
The lookup resumes and the surrounding operation continues with assumptions about the container’s prior internal representation.
The operation accesses inconsistent or invalidated table state and terminates instead of safely handling the reentrant mutation.
summary: Reentrant container mutation invalidates an active lookup
